name: landing example

on: 
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs: 
  hola:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps: 
      - name: hola mundo
        run: echo "Hola mundo"

      - name: touch file
        run: touch hola_anzye.txt

      - name: set text
        run: echo "Hola anzye" >> hola_anzye.txt

      - name: read file
        run: cat hola_anzye.txt


  other:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: hola
    steps: 
      - name: checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: ls
        run: ls -al
